source:
@@U03760@@
Go, now. Pile up treasure on treasure! Create a display so exalted it has never been seen! Let our vaulted halls glisten like skies new-fashioned! Make paradises out of lifeless life! Roll out soft flowered carpets for her to tread on. Let her see splendor that would dazzle all but the gods!

@@U03762@@
Your orders, sir, are child’s play to me. Little sooner said than done. This supreme beauty makes all things her servants. Our army’s already tamed, every sword blunt and lamed, and the sun itself is cold and dull compared with her radiant beauty. So grand a vision turns all things empty and base.

@@U03764@@
(To 浮士德.)

@@U03765@@
I wish to speak to you, but come and sit beside me. This empty seat calls for its master who safeguards mine.

@@U03767@@
First let me kneel, noble lady, and pledge you my heart! Then kiss the hand that raises me to your side! Confirm me now as coregent of your realm that knows no bounds, and allow me to be to you, all in one, admirer, servant, and guardian.

@@U03769@@
e I’ve seen and heard so many wonders,
translation:
@@U03760@@
走吧，现在。财宝堆积如山！打造前所未有的尊贵展示！让我们的拱形大厅像新式的天空一样闪闪发光！把毫无生气的生命变成天堂！铺上柔软的花地毯让她踩在上面。让她看到除了众神之外所有人都眼花缭乱的辉煌！

@@U03762@@
先生，您的命令对我来说简直就是小孩子的游戏。说起来比做起来快。这种至高无上的美丽使万物成为她的仆人。我们的军队已经被驯服了，每一把剑都变得钝了、跛了，与她光彩照人的美丽相比，太阳本身显得寒冷而暗淡。如此宏伟的愿景使一切变得空虚和卑鄙。

@@U03764@@
（致浮士德。）

@@U03765@@
我想和你说话，但是请过来坐在我旁边。这个空座位需要它的主人来保护我的。

@@U03767@@
首先请让我跪下，高贵的女士，向您宣誓我的心！然后亲吻那只把我举到你身边的手！现在确认我作为你们无边无际的王国的共同统治者，并允许我对你们来说，是一位崇拜者、仆人和守护者。

@@U03769@@
e I’ve seen and heard so many wonders,
